examples.zh: 在辯論中她的論點相當具說服力。

ENCLOSE.example: He said he had enclosed the receipt in the package.
ENCLOSE.exampleZh: 他說他已經將收據隨信附在包裹裡了。

examples.en: He said he had enclosed the receipt in the package.
examples.zh: 他說他已經將收據隨信附在包裹裡了。

examples.en: If she had enclosed her resume, we would have reviewed her application.
examples.zh: 如果她有附上履歷，我們就會審查她的申請了。

ACCOMPLISH.example: She told her boss she had accomplished all her tasks for the week.
ACCOMPLISH.exampleZh: 她告訴老闆她已經完成了這週所有的任務。

examples.en: She told her boss she had accomplished all her tasks for the week.
examples.zh: 她告訴老闆她已經完成了這週所有的任務。

examples.en: If we worked together closely, we could accomplish so much more.
examples.zh: 如果我們密切合作，我們就能完成更多事情。

OVERVIEW.example: He mentioned that he had read the project overview before the meeting.
OVERVIEW.exampleZh: 他提到他在會議前已經讀過專案概述了。

examples.en: He mentioned that he had read the project overview before the meeting.
examples.zh: 他提到他在會議前已經讀過專案概述了。

examples.en: If you gave me a brief overview, I would understand the plan much better.
examples.zh: 如果你給我一個簡短的概述，我就會更了解這個計畫。

FAULTY.example: She claimed that the item she had received was faulty.
FAULTY.exampleZh: 她聲稱她收到的商品是有缺陷的。

examples.en: She claimed that the item she had received was faulty.
examples.zh: 她聲稱她收到的商品是有缺陷的。

examples.en: If the engine hadn't been faulty, the flight would have departed on time.
examples.zh: 如果引擎沒有故障，航班就會準時起飛了。

COMPENSATE.example: The company promised they would compensate us for the massive loss.
COMPENSATE.exampleZh: 公司承諾他們會為這巨大的損失補償我們。

examples.en: The company promised they would compensate us for the massive loss.
examples.zh: 公司承諾他們會為這巨大的損失補償我們。

examples.en: If they hadn't compensated the clients, they would have faced severe legal action.
examples.zh: 如果他們沒有賠償客戶，就會面臨嚴厲的法律行動。

APOLOGY.example: He told me he had already written an official apology letter.
APOLOGY.exampleZh: 他告訴我他已經寫了一封正式的道歉信。

examples.en: He told me he had already written an official apology letter.
examples.zh: 他告訴我他已經寫了一封正式的道歉信。

examples.en: If she offered a sincere apology, I would certainly forgive her.
examples.zh: 如果她真誠地道歉，我一定會原諒她。

CRITICISM.example: He admitted that he had previously ignored their constructive criticism.
CRITICISM.exampleZh: 他承認他之前忽視了他們具建設性的批評。

examples.en: He admitted that he had previously ignored their constructive criticism.
examples.zh: 他承認他之前忽視了他們具建設性的批評。

examples.en: If you accepted criticism more openly, you would improve much faster.
examples.zh: 如果你能更敞開心胸接受批評，你就會進步得更快。

SUMMARIZE.example: She summarized what they had extensively discussed in the morning meeting.
SUMMARIZE.exampleZh: 她總結了他們在早會上廣泛討論的內容。

examples.en: She summarized what they had extensively discussed in the morning meeting.
examples.zh: 她總結了他們在早會上廣泛討論的內容。

examples.en: If you could summarize the whole article in one paragraph, it would be great.
examples.zh: 如果你能將整篇文章總結成一個段落，那就太好了。

SPECIFY.example: The client complained that we hadn't specified the delivery date.
SPECIFY.exampleZh: 客戶抱怨我們沒有明確指出交貨日期。

examples.en: The client complained that we hadn't specified the delivery date.
examples.zh: 客戶抱怨我們沒有明確指出交貨日期。

examples.en: If the contract specified the terms clearly, there would be no confusion.
examples.zh: 如果合約有明確說明條款，就不會產生混淆了。

UNACCEPTABLE.example: They declared that the sudden delay had been completely unacceptable.
UNACCEPTABLE.exampleZh: 他們宣稱那次突然的延誤是完全無法接受的。

examples.en: They declared that the sudden delay had been completely unacceptable.
examples.zh: 他們宣稱那次突然的延誤是完全無法接受的。

examples.en: If the overall quality were this poor, it would be unacceptable to our clients.
examples.zh: 如果整體品質這麼差，對我們的客戶來說將是無法接受的。

INCONVENIENCE.example: They apologized for the inconvenience they had caused.
INCONVENIENCE.exampleZh: 他們為所造成的不便道歉。

examples.en: They apologized for the inconvenience they had caused.
examples.zh: 他們為所造成的不便道歉。

examples.en: If we had informed them earlier, it wouldn't have caused such a huge inconvenience.
examples.zh: 如果我們早點通知他們，就不會造成這麼大的不便了。

DISSATISFIED.example: The customer wrote that he had been dissatisfied with the service.
DISSATISFIED.exampleZh: 那位顧客寫道他對這項服務一直很不滿意。

examples.en: The customer wrote that he had been dissatisfied with the service.
examples.zh: 那位顧客寫道他對這項服務一直很不滿意。

examples.en: If I were dissatisfied with the product, I would demand a full refund.
examples.zh: 如果我對這個產品不滿意，我會要求全額退款。
